notes:
## What's new

- Added built-in settings profiles on the main launcher UI: Recommended Settings and Personal Settings
- Launcher updates now reset the shipped Recommended Settings profile to the new bundled defaults
- Added a one-time post-update notice explaining that recommended settings were refreshed
- Fixed profile switching so both Recommended and Personal persist independently
- Updated the shipped recommended feature settings to match the latest launcher-saved recommended profile

## Other included improvements

- Segmented healthbar toggle
- Edo SZ font override expansion and chat font flash fix
- WSI scale runtime sync improvements
- Auto-import of newly added files in audio, mesh, and texture replacers
